      "login": "supertestnet",

      "note": "supported feature to simulate protocols paying multiple coinbase recipients like ocean and braidpool"

    },
    {
      "login": "maflcko",

      "note": "objected to modifying production miner code in src/node for test-only logic"
    },
    {
      "login": "mzumsande",
      "stance": "question",
      "note": "asked for motivation to be documented on GitHub rather than Twitter"
    },
    {
      "login": "naiyoma",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "asked for clarification between approaches, summarized testing, and offered style nits"
    },
    {
      "login": "achow101",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to breaking backwards compatibility for single string parameter in generateblock"
    },
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "question",
      "note": "asked if custom split rewards were planned to be included in this PR"
    },
    {
      "login": "stickies-v",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to limiting the RPC interface to equal splits instead of implementing custom rewards directly"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:2873256932",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "adding a new generatetomany RPC incurs code bloat, extra test maintenance, and deprecation cycles when extending generateblock is more flexible and fixes reward fee issues",
      "quote": "New RPCs require adding more code to test, and once added must go through a deprecation cycle to be removed (if they can be removed at all without disrupting too many users).",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:2873672475",
        "c:2879033872",
        "c:2907738036"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:2907738036",
      "settled_by_quote": "Squashed all commits and removed the first approach (`generatetomany`)"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2083512984",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "harm": "modifying core consensus/node miner logic in src/node to accommodate test-only mining behavior introduces dead code and maintenance burden",
      "quote": "Generally, I am not sure about modifying real code to accommodate test-only code. It would be better to not modify `src/node` at all and just put the test-only code in the test-only code paths.",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2083578626",
        "rc:2083962636",
        "rc:2084243740"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:2084243740",
      "settled_by_quote": "Tried to follow your approach, actually it makes things easier :)"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2112898168",
      "kind": "interface",
      "harm": "requiring an array rather than continuing to accept a string breaks backwards compatibility for scripts and automated tests using generateblock",
      "quote": "Although this RPC is only used by tests, I don't think we should be breaking backwards compatibility here. It's equally easy to determine whether this parameter is a string, so we can accept a string here for backwards compatibility.",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2113587244",
        "rc:2115811246",
        "c:2922380999",
        "c:3336297423"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:3336297423",
      "settled_by_quote": "{ \"generateblock\", 0, \"outputs\", /*also_string=*/true},"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2971839554",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "omitting the transaction parameter in existing functional tests changes their behavior to mine the mempool instead of generating empty blocks",
      "quote": "Otherwise this should be backwards compatible, and mining the mempool instead of an empty block can be a behavior change in the tests.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2986422097"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:2986422097",
      "settled_by_quote": "I will add back the `transactions=[]` you are right that is a behavior change and this PR should not be changing that. Thanks."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4289642909",
      "kind": "interface",
      "harm": "limiting the RPC interface to equal splits rather than supporting custom reward amounts handicaps its usefulness for the sake of CLI convenience",
      "quote": "Custom rewards are the general solution, why not just implement that right away? It's useful to keep the CLI commands ergonomic, but I think it's a mistake to handicap the RPC interface just to make CLI more ergonomic.",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4482515300",
        "c:4498871355",
        "c:5702616764"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:5702616764",
      "settled_by_quote": "Bicaru20 implemented the custom split rewards."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:2873215557",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "The generatetomany command would be particularly useful for simulating protocols that send money to multiple recipients directly from a coinbase, as several pools do now, like ocean and braidpool.",
      "substantive": true
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Initial implementation added a new generatetomany RPC and altered src/node/miner.cpp. Following reviewer feedback, the author extended generateblock instead, moved test-only logic to RPC mining code, maintained string backwards compatibility, and incorporated custom split rewards."
}
